brief: The canvas displays an intricate, ethereal lattice constructed from delicate, glowing lines. These bright lines form a vast network of connectivity, but occasionally, momentary gaps appear, breaking the continuous flow of light. The visual impact is defined by a powerful contrast: the vibrant luminescence of the glowing threads sharply contrasts against a surrounding, deep darkness. The structure appears to shift and subtly evolve over time, creating the illusion of a delicate, living web of light and shadow that continuously changes.

The network appears to breathe with life as individual threads subtly move and occasionally break their connections, forming temporary gaps in the web.
